title: Witchs' Sunflower Ritual
description: Three witches in black and green outfits perform a ritual in a garden of giant sunflowers. One witch stirs a glowing purple potion on a stone table while another carries a massive sunflower; in the background a cottage stands near a massive swirling vortex containing a giant skull emerging from turbulent green waves.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene with three witches wearing black corsets and green tutus performing a ritual in a sunflower garden at night. One witch stirs a glowing purple cauldron on a stone table filled with potions and jars, another carries an enormous sunflower, while a third stands near a small cottage with a red door. In the stormy sky a massive swirling vortex of purple and green contains a giant white skull rising from turbulent green waves, yellow petals flying through the air, dramatic lighting, detailed linework
